scenes.title: Just keep swimming!
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Dory
lines.text: When life gets you down, you know what you gotta do?
lines.hint: 当生活让你沮丧时，你知道该怎么办吗？

lines.speaker: Marlin
lines.text: I don't wanna know what you gotta do.
lines.hint: 我不想知道你要怎么办。

lines.speaker: Dory
lines.text: Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming, swimming, swimming, swimming.
lines.hint: 一直游下去。一直游下去。游啊，游啊，游啊。

lines.speaker: Dory
lines.text: What do we do? We swim, swim.
lines.hint: 我们要做什么？我们游啊，游啊。

scenes.title: Prove you can fly!
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Buzz
lines.text: I tell you, I could fly around this room with my eyes closed.
lines.hint: 告诉你，我闭着眼睛都能绕着房间飞。

lines.speaker: Woody
lines.text: Okay, then, Mr. Lightyear. Prove it.
lines.hint: 那好吧，光年先生。证明给我看。

lines.speaker: Buzz
lines.text: All right, then I will. Stand back, everyone.
lines.hint: 好，我来证明。大家往后站。

scenes.title: You are a toy!
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Woody
lines.text: You are a toy! You aren't the real Buzz Lightyear! You're an action figure! You are a child's plaything!
lines.hint: 你是个玩具！你不是真正的巴斯光年！你是一个人偶，是孩子的玩具！

lines.speaker: Buzz
lines.text: You are a sad, strange little man, and you have my pity. Farewell.
lines.hint: 你是一个可怜又奇怪的小家伙，我同情你。告辞。

lines.speaker: Woody
lines.text: Oh, yeah? Well, good riddance, you loony!
lines.hint: 哦，是吗？走了正好，你这个疯子！

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment on prepared source audio

scenes.title: Thunder comes after lightning
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Chick Hicks
lines.text: Hey, fellas, how do you think I'd look in Dinoco blue?
lines.hint: 嘿，伙计们，你们觉得我涂上恐龙石油的蓝色会怎么样？

lines.speaker: Chick Hicks
lines.text: Yeah, right. Thunder? What's he talking about, thunder?
lines.hint: 是啊，才怪。雷声？他为什么说雷声？

lines.speaker: Lightning McQueen
lines.text: You know, because thunder always comes after lightning! Ka-chow!
lines.hint: 你知道的，因为雷声总在闪电之后！咔嚓！

scenes.title: Anyone can cook?
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Gusteau
lines.text: How do you know? What do I always say? Anyone can cook.
lines.hint: 你怎么知道？我常说什么？谁都能做饭。

lines.speaker: Remy
lines.text: Well, yeah, anyone can. That doesn't mean that anyone should.

scenes.title: There is no secret ingredient
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ping
lines.text: Come here. The secret ingredient is nothing.
lines.hint: 过来。秘密配料就是——什么都没有。

lines.speaker: Mr. Ping
lines.text: You heard me. Nothing. There is no secret ingredient.
lines.hint: 你没听错。什么都没有。没有什么秘密配料。

lines.speaker: Po
lines.text: Wait, wait. It's just plain old noodle soup? You don't add some kind of special sauce or something?
lines.hint: 等等，就是普通的面汤？你没有加什么特别的酱料之类的吗？

lines.speaker: Mr. Ping
lines.text: Don't have to. To make something special, you just have to believe it's special.
lines.hint: 不需要。要让一样东西变得特别，只需要相信它是特别的。

lines.hint: 我理解。你不开心的时候就会吃东西。

lines.speaker: Po
lines.text: Upset? I'm not upset. What makes you think I'm upset?
lines.hint: 不开心？我没有不开心。你为什么觉得我不开心？

lines.text: Honey, why don't you go check on the cake?
lines.hint: 亲爱的，你去看看蛋糕好吗？

lines.speaker: Fiona

scenes.title: Smile, wave, and plan the escape
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Skipper
lines.text: Just smile and wave, boys. Smile and wave.
lines.hint: 小伙子们，微笑，挥挥手。微笑，挥挥手。

scenes.title: M for mini, W for Wumbo
scenes.titleZh: M 是迷你，W 是 Wumbo
scenes.editNote: Expanded to include the surrounding character exchange and its payoff.

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: You know what the problem is?

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: You got it set to M for mini, when it should be set to W for Wumbo.
lines.hint: 你把它设成了代表迷你的 M，而它应该设成代表 Wumbo 的 W。

lines.speaker: SpongeBob
lines.text: Patrick, I don't think Wumbo is a real word.
lines.hint: 派大星，我觉得 Wumbo 不是一个真正的词。

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: Come on! You know, I Wumbo, you Wumbo. He, she, me, Wumbo.
lines.hint: 别这样！你知道的，我 Wumbo，你 Wumbo，他、她、我，Wumbo。（这是剧中的虚构词。）

scenes.title: 怪物就像洋葱
scenes.editNote: Original user-selected benchmark; media bytes preserved.

lines.speaker: 史莱克
lines.text: No! Layers! Onions have layers. Ogres have layers. Onions have layers.
lines.hint: 不！层次！洋葱有层次，怪物也有层次。

lines.speaker: 史莱克
lines.text: You get it? We both have layers.
lines.hint: 你明白了吗？我们都有层次。
